Describe the log posterior of a phase model

Source: R/posterior_target.R
posterior_target.Rd

Both backends evaluate the log posterior through this description: the NUTS sampler in phaseR_nuts_sampler() and the Laplace approximation. A model with K phases has K - 1 transition linear predictors (the logit of moving from phase k to k + 1) and K dynamics linear predictors (the mean of each phase on the scale of its link). Each is a fixed-effect design matrix plus random-effect terms, whose parameters sit at the offsets of the parameter vector that prepare_stan_data() names.

Usage

posterior_target(stan_data)

Arguments

stan_data

Prepared data list

Value

List with kind = "phase", n_params, n_phases, the outcome y, the 0-based observation range of each unit (unit_start, unit_end), the outcome family code and number of trials of each phase, the 0-based offset of the log residual SDs (sigma_offset), the linear predictors (transitions, dynamics; each a list with design matrix X, 0-based coefficient offset and random-effect terms re) and the prior of each parameter class (prior, from prior_to_cpp())
